column1: # Target loci to extract from GCF_000157895.3 (M. kansasii ATCC 12478, ASM15789v2)
# Coordinates are NOT hardcoded - they are resolved from the assembly GFF by 02_make_targets.py.
# gene_aliases : comma-separated gene/Name values to match in the GFF (case-insensitive)
# product_regex: fallback regex matched against the product= qualifier (for rRNA, which is
#                often annotated without a gene= key). Use NONE to disable. Anchor with ^...$
#                where the product text is a prefix of other products (e.g. L3 vs L31/L32).
# feature_types: GFF feature types to accept, comma-separated
# pad          : bp of flank to add on each side in the padded BED (promoters, uORFs)
# numbering_ref: which external sequence the published marker coordinates are expressed in
#                (see refs/ and markers.tsv). NONE = report in M. kansasii coordinates only.
